title: General Hux's Request
description: Shocked by General Hux's assist, Finn, Poe Dameron and Chewbacca take advantage of the opportunity and continue their escape. It becomes clear by his own admission that Hux is not a Resistance sympathizer or ally of Poe and Finn, but rather he wants to do all he can to sabotage the rule of Ren. To hide his deception, Hux asks Finn to blast him.
